source_snapshot.procedure: Use `lspci -nn` and verbose `lspci -s <PCIe_Bus>` to check BF3 PCIe device/vendor ID, speed and bandwidth.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; uses first Mellanox match, insecure access and truncates verbose output.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require exact BF3 BDF/SKU/root port, complete numeric output and an authoritative link-bandwidth oracle.

old_problem: The source BDF and SPEC were placeholders and did not define whether bandwidth meant negotiated theoretical PCIe capacity or measured throughput. DeepSeek could select the wrong Mellanox function and discarded capability/error fields with `head`.
disposition_reason: Numeric PCI enumeration and exact-BDF verbose capability/link data are standard read-only evidence. ED-03 allows the BF3 identity, root-port map and expected field matrix to be project configuration; ED-15 prevents PASS until the bandwidth definition and signed link limits exist. No firmware or traffic benchmark is inferred.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row386 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2979 and unique variant.

Distinguished numeric device/subsystem identity, maximum link capability, negotiated generation/width and derived theoretical link rate; any measured-throughput requirement remains separately declared.
Retained BF3 vendor/device ID, speed, bandwidth, full `lspci` coverage, 10-minute allocations and SPEC comparison while rejecting first-device selection and truncation.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row387 and verified its manifest identity; no lspci, network, firmware or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: BF3 exact-function PCIe identity, capability and negotiated-link conformance
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved BlueField 3 PCIe function has the signed numeric identity and that capable and negotiated generation/width plus the declared bandwidth calculation match platform SPEC without configuration changes.
required_package: BF3 model/serial/PSID/slot and domain:BDF/function/root-port topology map
Expected vendor/device/subsystem IDs and required function inventory
Signed maximum and negotiated PCIe generation/width matrix plus link-rate/bandwidth formula, units and tolerance
Pinned pciutils version and optional approved read-only mlxlink/devlink evidence if the SPEC requires it
Pre/post AER/kernel/BMC evidence and secure complete collection path
test_case.test_command: Preserve existing logs; collect full `lspci -Dnn`, bind every required BF3 function to the signed physical/topology map, then retain untruncated `lspci -D -s <verified-domain:BDF> -nnvvv` output for each function and its root port. Compare numeric IDs, capabilities and negotiated link fields, calculate bandwidth only with the approved formula, and collect any separately approved read-only fabric evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Every required BF3 function appears exactly once at its mapped BDF; numeric IDs and capabilities match SPEC; negotiated link generation and width meet signed expectations; the approved derived or measured bandwidth value satisfies its floor/tolerance; no new downgrade, retrain, AER or platform-health anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete identity/topology provenance, untruncated endpoint and root-port evidence and signed field/bandwidth comparisons. First-grep selection, product text, a capable rate without negotiated state or a value without an approved formula/floor cannot pass.
safety_gate: Select targets only from the signed serial/SKU/slot/BDF map, never first Mellanox output
Use read-only commands and preserve diagnostic logs; do not reset/retrain/configure the link
Collect complete endpoint/root-port capabilities and AER context without credential or host-key bypass
Stop and report on target ambiguity, disappearance, downgrade/retrain or new AER; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: pciutils/tool versions and full numeric inventory
Untruncated endpoint and root-port verbose output for every required function
Capable versus negotiated generation/width and approved bandwidth calculation/floor/tolerance
Optional approved read-only mlxlink/devlink plus pre/post AER/kernel/BMC evidence
test_case.recovery: No mutation is authorized. On missing/degraded function or new error, preserve all evidence and stop; do not rescan, retrain, reset, flash or reboot automatically. Escalate to the separately approved PCIe/BlueField recovery owner.

source_conflict.reason: Master and historical AI target the same BF3 PCIe information; heuristic selection and truncation are corrected implementation defects, not competing requirements.

blocked.reason: Standard read-only collection and comparison are complete; exact topology and signed bandwidth semantics are execution prerequisites.
